items.fact: The campaign has five chapters and 91 story missions, following Jason and Lucia through Leonida's criminal underworld.

The chapters are Just Like Paradise (Leonida Keys, 22 missions), Paradise Lost (Port Gellhorn, 11 plus 3 optional), Tits, Ass, Drug Money (Vice City, 26 plus 1 optional), Vice City, Baby (25), and Top of the World, Ma (7).
Chapter 2 ends with the mission Checking Out, once you reach the Move to Vice City marker. Do the optional missions and grab the motel collectibles before then.
Jason and Lucia are the two playable leads, and you can switch between them. Larger robberies and illegal operations are easier if you bring your partner along.
There are 18 collectible card sets, and sets range from 12 to 36 cards each. Dexerto's map lists 103 cards found so far.
Collecting three cards in each of the five counties unlocks the Collectible Cards achievement, and cards can be sold for cash.
There are 33 Underwater Discovery locations. Kenton's Treasures are 8 of them, and you dig these up with a metal detector and sell them to Kenton.
There are 45 Magazine Styles that unlock cosmetic looks for Jason and Lucia, and you collect them by scanning with the WAiNK app.
There are 35 WAiNK Curiosities, which are small odd objects or bits of infrastructure scattered around Leonida.
Leonida is split into five counties. Named areas include Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Vice City, Hamlet and Key Lento.
Large bank vault robberies pay up to $200,000. They unlock near the end of Chapter 4 and require finishing a side quest and two Payday Loan jobs.
Randy's Wish List has 18 high-end sports cars. Delivering one can pay $30,000 or more, and the list opens partway through Chapter 3.
Moses buys untracked stolen cars from Chapter 2 for about $1,000 to $5,000 each. Check for trackers with the WAiNK app first.
Gang hideouts respawn and can pay $10,000 to $30,000 per run. The writer recommends farming them in the late game.
There are 40 unique race locations. Entry and vehicle rental fees apply, but winning pays more than you spend.
Ultimate Edition content includes a Dinka Enduro motorcycle and Crest Kayak at Jason's house in Chapter 1. It also includes One-Eyed Willie's off-road mod shop and Rideout Customs in Vice City.
Make manual saves often. After Missing Persons in Chapter 3, some players got stuck with Jason greyed out, and reloading an older manual save helped some of them.
In Chapter 4, killing Felipe in Bad Driver! gives $20,000 right away. Sparing him unlocks a car in a later mission, and you should finish it before starting Power Play.
Chapter 1 caps your BuckMe account at $15,000 and savings at $5,000, so hoarding cash early is pointless.
Update 01.002.002 came out on November 23, 2026. It fixes crashes, autosaving, weather that wouldn't change, phone calls that didn't trigger, and being unable to lose a Wanted level.
The same update also fixed the gym deadlift bar and partners not handing over bags to sell to fences.
The patch notes don't mention a glitch that forces first-person view or an Xbox glitch that unlocks 60fps, so both still work.
